additional_info.body:
Dear RC- DE Team,
Could you please confirm if the DP (Display Port) cable has been changed with a new one?
Could you please confirm if the D-logic firmware has been updated to the charger, if not we shall update it.
We need to check the power supply to the control board if there is 24VDC on the cables, but the display controller PCB is not powering ON, we need to replace the complete HMI with the generation2.
Also please refer attached document for ordering spare part.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0389702 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2
) to the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):

Maybe

Yes

Yes

Performance monitoring by RC

" option in the queue, or manually using the "

eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
